stateConflicts.owner: L8.8: the guard that refuses a group whose mapped states disagree belongs to scripts/computed-route/lib/solve-rows.mjs, not to this lane. This file only names the seven so L8 can test against them.
stateConflicts.keys: Each entry is a committed triage verdict (sites/eye-care-ward-end/build/qa/triage/<surface>.json, verdicts[].key) whose pair is measured in two or more walker states that now map to the SAME setting state with different draft values. Writing the group would take the last run's value. The `mappedTo` list is each walker state's mapped setting state as committed. The reasons state only what is committed (the states and where they map); the differing draft values are as recorded in C0.7.
